license_required.quote: A person who, not being licensed, advertises or holds himself or herself out to the public as described in section 1311 of this title, or who, not being licensed, practices medicine as defined in section 1311 of this title ... shall be imprisoned not more than two years or fined not more than $10,000.00, or both.

issuing_authority.quote: The Board of Medical Practice is created.

name.quote: The Board of Medical Practice is created.

type.quote: The Board shall be composed of 17 members, nine of whom shall be licensed physicians, one of whom shall be a physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 31 of this title, one of whom shall be a podiatrist licensed pursuant to chapter 7 of this title, and six of whom shall be persons not associated with the medical field.

umbrella_agency.quote: The Board of Medical Practice is established as an office within the Department of Health.

age_minimum.quote: is at least 18 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: is of sound moral character and professional competence as evidenced by

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine or equivalent from an accredited medical school
degree_required.quote: has graduated from a medical school accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board, or from a medical school that has been approved by the Board by rule, with a degree of doctor of medicine or an equivalent as may be determined by the Board

accrediting_body.value: Organization acceptable to the Board (e.g., LCME for faculty license)
accrediting_body.quote: graduated from a medical school accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board, or from a medical school that has been approved by the Board by rule

degree_level.quote: with a degree of doctor of medicine or an equivalent as may be determined by the Board

school_approval_basis.quote: graduated from a medical school accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board, or from a medical school that has been approved by the Board by rule

credential_pegged.quote: has graduated from a medical school accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board, or from a medical school that has been approved by the Board by rule, with a degree of doctor of medicine or an equivalent

required.quote: A graduate of a U.S. or Canadian medical school accredited by a body that is acceptable to the Board shall submit evidence of the successful completion of at least two years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

experience_source.quote: A graduate of a U.S. or Canadian medical school accredited by a body that is acceptable to the Board shall submit evidence of the successful completion of at least two years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

duration.value: at least two years (U.S./Canadian graduates); at least three years (foreign graduates)
duration.quote: at least two years of postgraduate training ... A graduate of a Board-approved medical school outside the United States or Canada shall submit evidence of success of completing at least three years of postgraduate training

kind.value: postgraduate training in accredited U.S. or Canadian program
kind.quote: postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

exams.name: Medical licensing examination (Board-specified, e.g., USMLE/COMLEX-USA)
exams.notes: The Board may identify which examinations are accepted, set passing standards, and set limits on time and numbers of attempts for exams. The Board may establish by rule exceptions or alternative means to meet examination requirements.
exams.quote: An applicant shall satisfy the Board's requirements for medical licensing examination as established by the Board by rule. The Board may identify which examinations are accepted, set passing standards, and set limits on time and numbers of attempts for exams.

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed to practice medicine by the Board shall apply biennially for the renewal of his or her license.

required.quote: A licensee for renewal of an active license to practice medicine shall have completed continuing medical education that shall meet minimum criteria as established by rule, by the Board

hours_per_period.quote: The Board shall require a minimum of 10 hours of continuing medical education by rule.

period_years.quote: Every person licensed to practice medicine by the Board shall apply biennially for the renewal of his or her license.

available.quote: The Board shall have an endorsement process for physician licensure that requires not more than three years of practice in good standing in another jurisdiction within the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must have practiced in good standing in another U.S. jurisdiction for not more than three years and must meet postgraduate training requirements (at least two years for U.S./Canadian graduates, at least three years for foreign graduates).
requirements.quote: The Board shall have an endorsement process for physician licensure that requires not more than three years of practice in good standing in another jurisdiction within the United States, regardless of whether that jurisdiction has licensing requirements substantially equal to those of this State, provided the applicant meets one of the following postgraduate training requirements

national_association.quote: a physician who is Board-certified or Board-eligible in his or her field of specialty, as determined by the American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS)

credential_type.quote: License and certify health professionals pursuant to this title.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a medical license or its renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a medical license or in connection with applying for or procuring periodic renewal of a medical license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising about health care services intended or tending to mislead or deceive the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: all advertising about health care services or a medical business that is intended or has a tendency to mislead or deceive the public or impose upon credulous or ignorant persons

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: abandonment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that impair the licensee's ability to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promoting sale of drugs or devices in a manner that exploits the patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: promotion by a physician of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods provided for a patient in such a manner as to exploit the patient for financial gain of the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct that evidences unfitness to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct that evidences unfitness to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully making and filing false reports or records in his or her practice as a physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make available patient records upon proper request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to make available promptly to a person using professional health care services, that person's representative, succeeding health care professionals, or institutions, when given proper written request

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees for referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: division of fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for professional services for any person for bringing to or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful misrepresentation in treatments
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willful misrepresentation in treatments

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine with a physician who is not legally practicing within the State
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing medicine with a physician who is not legally practicing within the State, or aiding or abetting such physician in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross overcharging for professional services on repeated occasions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross overcharging for professional services on repeated occasions, including filing of false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetency resulting from physical or mental impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: professional incompetency resulting from physical or mental impairment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting one's name or license to be used by another person not actively in charge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: permitting one's name or license to be used by a person, group, or corporation when not actually in charge of, responsible for, or actively overseeing the treatment or other health care services provided

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross failure to use the degree of care, skill, and proficiency expected of an ordinary skillful physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross failure to use and exercise on a particular occasion or the failure to use and exercise on repeated occasions, that degree of care, skill, and proficiency that is commonly exercised by the ordinary skillful, careful, and prudent physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or disciplinary sanction by another jurisdiction on grounds specified in this section
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revocation of a license to practice medicine or surgery, or other disciplinary sanction, by another jurisdiction on one or more of the grounds specified in this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an order of the Board or violation of conditions of a restricted license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with an order of the Board or violation of any term or condition of a license that is restricted or conditioned by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing a nurse practitioner to perform acts outside the physician's scope or for which the NP is unqualified
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any physician who, in the course of a collaborative agreement with a nurse practitioner allows the nurse practitioner to perform a medical act that is outside the usual scope of the physician's own practice or that the nurse practitioner is not qualified to perform by training or experience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with federal or state statutes or regulations governing medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with provisions of federal statutes or regulations, or the statutes or rules of this or any other state, governing the practice of medicine or surgery

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of profession when medically or psychologically unfit to do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practice of profession when medically or psychologically unfit to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegation of professional responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, education, or credentials
disciplinary_grounds.quote: delegation of professional responsibilities, including delivery of any health care services, to a person whom the licensed professional knows, or has reason to know, is not qualified by training, experience, education, or licensing credentials to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime related to the profession or any felony, or failure to report such conviction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a crime related to the practice of the profession or conviction of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of the profession, or failure to report to the Board a conviction of any crime related to the practice of the profession or any felony in any court within 30 days of the conviction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing via electronic means without establishing a proper physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: providing, prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing medical services or prescription medication or prescription-only devices to a person in response to any communication transmitted or received by computer or other electronic means, when the licensee fails to take the following actions to establish and maintain a proper physician-patient relationship

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide the Board with information it reasonably requests
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to provide to the Board such information it may reasonably request in furtherance of its statutory duties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disruptive behavior that interferes with patient care or could adversely affect quality of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: disruptive behavior that involves interaction with physicians, hospital personnel, office staff, patients, or support persons of the patient or others that interferes with patient care or could reasonably be expected to adversely affect the quality of care rendered to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any sexual misconduct that exploits the physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commission of any sexual misconduct that exploits the physician-patient relationship, including sexual contact with a patient, surrogates, or key third parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, administering, or dispensing a controlled substance for the licensee's own use or to an immediate family member
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, ordering, or dispensing any drug legally classified as a controlled substance for the licensee's own use or to an immediate family member as defined by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a blank or undated prescription form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: signing a blank or undated prescription form

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of conversion therapy on a client younger than 18 years of age
disciplinary_grounds.quote: use of conversion therapy as defined in 18 V.S.A. § 8351 on a client younger than 18 years of age

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with notice, disclosure, or advertising requirements for unapproved stem cell products
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with one or more of the notice, disclosure, or advertising requirements in 18 V.S.A. § 4502 for administering stem cell or stem cell-related products not approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to practice competently, including unsafe patient care or failure to conform to acceptable standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to practice competently by reason of any cause on a single occasion or on multiple occasions constitutes unprofessional conduct. Failure to practice competently includes, as determined by the Board: (1) performance of unsafe or unacceptable patient care; or (2) failure to conform to the essential standards of acceptable and prevailing practice.

definition_quote.value: Practice of medicine includes using protected titles, advertising as authorized to practice, prescribing drugs, diagnosing or treating disease, performing surgical operations, rendering telehealth opinions, and determining medical necessity
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means: (A) using the designation "Doctor," "Doctor of Medicine," "Physician," "Dr.," "M.D.," ... (C) offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person; (D) offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person ... (E) offering or undertaking to perform any surgical operation upon any person

value: preventing, diagnosing, and treating disease and abnormal conditions
managing pregnancy, labor, delivery, and postpartum care
methods_authorized.quote: offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine ... offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person, including the management of all aspects of pregnancy, labor and delivery, and postpartum care ... offering or undertaking to perform any surgical operation upon any person ... rendering a written or otherwise documented medical opinion ... rendering a determination of medical necessity

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, order, give, and administer drugs and medicines; controlled substances are subject to restrictions including prohibition on self-prescribing.
drug_authority.quote: offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person

license_status_types.quote: The Board or the Executive Director of the Board may issue a temporary license to an individual who is currently licensed to practice as a physician ... The Board may issue a license without examination to a reputable physician who is a resident of a foreign country ... condition, limit, suspend, or revoke the license, certificate, or practice of the individual complained against

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Graduates of medical schools outside the U.S. or Canada must complete at least three years (vs. two for U.S./Canadian graduates) of postgraduate training in an accredited U.S. or Canadian program and must submit ECFMG certification unless qualifying as a Fifth Pathway applicant.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A graduate of a Board-approved medical school outside the United States or Canada shall submit evidence of success of completing at least three years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board ... A graduate of a medical school outside the United States or Canada shall also submit evidence of certification by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: A graduate of a U.S. or Canadian medical school accredited by a body that is acceptable to the Board shall submit evidence of the successful completion of at least two years of postgraduate training

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Prescribing via electronic means requires reasonable efforts to verify patient identity, documented diagnosis through accepted medical practices, and maintenance of a current medical record; electronic questionnaire-only evaluation is inadequate for initial evaluation except for pregnancy termination medication.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: providing, prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing medical services or prescription medication or prescription-only devices to a person in response to any communication transmitted or received by computer or other electronic means, when the licensee fails to take the following actions to establish and maintain a proper physician-patient relationship: (i) a reasonable effort to verify that the person requesting medication is in fact the patient ... (ii) establishment of documented diagnosis through the use of accepted medical practices; and (iii) maintenance of a current medical record

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The member states hereby create the "Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Commission."

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The Board or the Executive Director of the Board may waive supervision and scope of practice requirements for physician assistants, including the requirement for documentation of the relationship between a physician assistant and a physician pursuant to section 1735a of this title.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: All medical malpractice court judgments and all medical malpractice arbitration awards in which a payment is awarded to a complaining party during the last 10 years, and all settlements of medical malpractice claims in which a payment is made to a complaining party within the last 10 years.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A description of revocation or involuntary restriction of hospital privileges for reasons related to competence or character that has been issued by the hospital's governing body or any other official of the hospital after procedural due process has been afforded

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Require a licensee or applicant to submit to a mental or physical examination, and an evaluation of medical knowledge and skill by individuals or entities designated by the Board if the Board has a reasonable basis to believe a licensee or applicant may be incompetent or unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety.

scope__license_status_types.quote: The Board or the Executive Director of the Board may issue a temporary license to an individual who is currently licensed to practice as a physician, physician assistant, or podiatrist in another jurisdiction, whose license is in good standing, and who is not subject to disciplinary proceedings in any other jurisdiction.

"Expedited License" means a full and unrestricted medical license granted by a member state to an eligible physician through the process set forth in the Compact.
